_doc: Owner-committed approvals for build-time hard-law exceptions (canonical law: CLAUDE.md working-style item 6; checker: tools/check_build_time.py). Each entry: subject ('airport:<ICAO>' | 'tile:<short_latlon>' | '*'), metric ('total' | 'phase:<label>' | '*'), allowed_seconds (approved ceiling the measured value must stay under), reason (required, non-empty), approved_by (required), date. Hollow entries are ignored by the checker.

approvals.subject: airport:SPJC
approvals.reason: Recognizing the stock library's generic building facades (Misc_Buildings / lib/airport/buildings) in dsf_reader._building_role_for_def admits 49 previously-dropped building footprints at SPJC (25 Cargo_Terminal, 21 warehouse/office, 3 others) -> 94 building pads vs 60. SPJC's cargo apron previously got pavement pads but no building pads, so those structures rode the ungraded DEM. Cost: 84.41 -> 86.45 s median (+2.04 s, 3.4% of the 60 s budget; SPJC was already over budget). Fable 5 optimization agent 2026-07-24 found the increase is NOT in reading or clustering the facades (geometry phases flat) but the legitimate downstream price of 34 more real pads in the elevation phase: pad seating/coupling, pavement-pad stitching, strip construction, and 26 more rigid pad groups in the final projections (+0.4 s); the solver core is unchanged (+0.18 s) and the grade graph shrinks slightly as pads displace apron area. Offset identified and queued separately: junction_rules.stitch_pavement_to_terminals re-extracts every building ring per pavement vertex with no spatial prefilter, expected to recover more than 2 s.

approvals.subject: airport:SPJC
approvals.reason: KILL-HALF DEFAULTS FLIP (docs/specs/kill-half-spec.md §1): the 11 candidate gates ship ON, so every user build now runs the route-metric envelope, the lateral-contiguity law and its service-lot absorption, the exact route-leg pricing, the drainage-spine and runway-strip-wall laws, the source-coverage invariant, the needle source guard, the triangle-plane report and the exact band seeding.  Measured cost at SPJC (flip battery + solve-profile round, 3 cold-equivalent runs per arm, foreground and exclusive): 144.7 s gates-off -> 153.2 s gates-on, +8.5 s, entirely inside the solve phase (90.5 -> 102.2 s).  SPJC was already over the 60 s per-airport budget before the flip.  The owner approved this regression on 2026-08-04; the approval is recorded in the b56b37a commit.  This ceiling is the gates-on median measured there.
